name: glowing-stars

frames.best_why: Frame 6 has nearly every star lit white from the hover, more than the few scattered flashes in the others.

tagline: Tiny stars dot a dark card and flare white when the cursor crosses it.
summary: A dark rounded card with a grid of one-pixel stars over its top half and a title and description beneath. Random stars flicker on a timer, and hovering lights the whole field.
appearance: A tall rounded card in a soft dark grey-brown gradient, its upper two thirds a wide grid of tiny grey dots. Near the bottom a bold white title sits over two lines of pale grey copy, and lit dots gain a small blue halo.
behaviour: Every three seconds five random dots swell and flash white-blue before fading. Hovering the card lights all of them at once with a staggered cascade, and they drop back to random flicker when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Title "Component Library" with a description about Radix UI and Tailwind CSS and a note to hover for the glow.
search_phrases: stars that light up on hover
tiny lights blinking in a grid
card with random sparkles on loop
use_when: A feature or product card needs a quiet space theme and a small hover payoff.
avoid_when: You need the star field read at a glance on touch, or strong contrast in the body copy.
customise: Title and description are passed as children, and each subcomponent takes a className. The 108 dots, 18-column grid, blue glow and three-second interval are fixed in the source.
weight_why: 108 dot nodes each with their own motion and blue glow layers.

a11y.note: The full-grid glow happens on hover only with no focus or keyboard route, and the flicker ignores reduced-motion.

issues: Before they glow the 1px dots are nearly invisible, so the card looks almost blank at rest.
Hover is the only way to light the whole grid, so touch users only ever see random flicker.
polish_why: Muted card and believable flicker, but the unlit grid looks empty and the payoff is hover-only.
title: Glowing Stars
